items.question: What is Janel McCarville doing now?
items.answer: Janel McCarville is an assistant coach for the Minnesota Lynx. The Lynx hired her for the 2026 season after she coached the girls' team at her old high school, Stevens Point Area Senior High in Wisconsin.

items.question: Which WNBA teams did Janel McCarville play for?
items.answer: Janel McCarville was the No. 1 pick of the 2005 WNBA Draft by the Charlotte Sting. She later played for the New York Liberty (2007 to 2010) and the Minnesota Lynx (2013, 2014 and 2016), won the 2007 Most Improved Player award and won the 2013 WNBA title with Minnesota.

items.question: What were Janel McCarville's career averages?
items.answer: Janel McCarville averaged 7.7 points, 4.4 rebounds and 1.9 assists in 286 WNBA regular-season games. Her best scoring season was 2008, at 13.7 points per game for New York.

items.question: Did Janel McCarville play for the Minnesota Gophers?
items.answer: Yes. Janel McCarville started four seasons at Minnesota and led the Gophers to their first Final Four in 2004. She is the program's career leader in rebounds.

items.question: How tall is Janel McCarville?
items.answer: Basketball-Reference lists Janel McCarville at 6 feet 2 inches. She played forward and center.
